interpretation: Research register: impact is ordinal and conditional on exposure; likelihood/failure frequency is unestimated. Evidence basis is not the product evidence-strength score. No RPN, probability ranking, exhaustive-coverage claim, new scope approval or completed acceptance is implied.

risks.title: Data acquisition/use rights
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: No actual entitlement for retained history/non-display/derived public use is supplied.
risks.early_signal: Accessible wrapper or consumer subscription is used as permission.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Record exact source/use/retention/redistribution scope and obtain admitted evidence before live publication.

risks.title: Cumulative budget and unspecified horizon
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: TRY5000 is total, while selected configuration, workload, duration and complete prices are unknown.
risks.early_signal: Renewals/usage are omitted or ceiling is treated as monthly.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Price a chosen horizon and reconcile actual+committed+reserved+contingency; do not spend or reduce scope to force fit.

risks.title: Fund field coverage and cash nonidentifiability
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Dated AUM/count/allocation are unverified; endpoints alone do not generally identify cash or selling.
risks.early_signal: Placeholder/latest field is dated by NAV; residual is titled redemptions or asset sales.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Admit raw dated fields/actions and independently reconcile disclosed transactions; otherwise publish only correctly named dated facts/conditional estimate.

risks.title: Mixed venue/unit/cadence histories
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: US feed scope, fund cadence, crypto venue and adjustment comparability differ.
risks.early_signal: IEX/SIP histories mix or fund NAV is shown as intraday.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Exercise feed/calendar/unit changes and preserve exact comparable source metadata and unavailable states.

risks.title: Four-market and on-chain prerequisite chain
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Accepted demonstration spans four domains plus meaningful chain evidence; source/account/runtime paths are absent.
risks.early_signal: One successful equity chart is called full coverage.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Prove a bounded meaningful path in every required domain and track unresolved dependencies without silently dropping one.

risks.title: Base rates, drift and invalid statistical guarantees
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Toy methods fail under deliberately shifted/misspecified processes; actual population rates are unknown.
risks.early_signal: One threshold or BH/BY result is advertised as stable financial precision.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Freeze natural-prevalence chronological evaluation with ordinary periods, prior-only selection, clustered uncertainty and all eligible denominators.

risks.title: Truth/causality overclaim and unvalidated natural language
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Citation support, arithmetic and agreeing origins do not establish world truth/cause; typed atoms are supplied.
risks.early_signal: High score or calculation permits extra causal/fraud prose.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Use independent unfamiliar Turkish claim labels, exact premise lineage/contradictions and actual rendering evaluation.

risks.title: Hindsight leakage, survivor selection and weak evaluation target
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Current revisions, survivors and retrospective interval scoring can change what the test measures.
risks.early_signal: Famous incidents/current holdings are used as historical truth or later hits are backdated.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Freeze available-at universe/records and targets, retain missing/delisted/excluded cases and untouched later evaluation.

risks.title: Unproven useful recurring job and payment
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: No observed user effort reduction, sustained use or willingness to pay.
risks.early_signal: Praise/curiosity is reported as demand; unusual facts remove no actual task burden.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Observe recent real jobs against usual workflow, then an ordinary-period pilot and any later separately authorized priced test.
risks.review_context: Business learning priority; not a new formal release gate or a condition silently added to G11.

risks.title: Advertised incumbent overlap and weak switching reason
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Current official competitors describe overlapping AI/fund/source/alert jobs; our task advantage is untested.
risks.early_signal: No-competitor claims or absent webpage feature is scored as competitor absence.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Compare the same five jobs with tier/date/coverage recorded; observe what users actually replace.
risks.review_context: Business learning priority; not a new formal release gate or a condition silently added to G11.

risks.title: Alert fatigue versus suppressed material events
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Duplicate noise and lost distinct events are separate; actual fatigue is unmeasured.
risks.early_signal: Notification caps/cooldown improve counts while distinct events vanish.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Score logical episodes, update burden, misses/latency and consenting-user comprehension together.

risks.title: Abstention and quiet states reduce visible value
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Policy-correct fixture abstentions do not estimate coverage; users may confuse silence with broken monitoring.
risks.early_signal: Unavailable coverage is shown as no risk, or trivial alerts fill quiet days.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Observe ordinary-period comprehension/return and separate unavailable, quiet, partial and review-required states.

risks.title: Authorization, session and cache isolation
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: RLS/session/admin/private-cache declarations have not run through actual integration.
risks.early_signal: Own-user routes bypass row policies or cached cookies/context cross users.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Run actual anonymous/A/B grants/RLS/session-revocation and SSR/cache tests with secret-role handling.

risks.title: Untrusted retrieval, SSRF and private-context exfiltration
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Read-only fetching can reach unsafe destinations or leak context; regex/schema gates are not runtime defense.
risks.early_signal: Retrieved text directs tools; redirects/DNS changes reach private transport.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Exercise actual server-controlled router/resolver/renderer against hostile pages, private redirects, DNS changes and secret-bearing queries.

risks.title: Revision/outbox races and uncertain sends
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Reference gates do not implement atomic publication, leases, crash recovery or provider acceptance reconciliation.
risks.early_signal: Old approval/consent is used after queueing; retries duplicate or lose logical intent.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Inject crashes and concurrent invalidation/withdrawal in real PostgreSQL with provider stub and recorded acceptance ledger.

risks.title: On-chain quota/finality/attribution coverage
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Public RPC reliability and exact coverage are unmeasured; confirmed/account/transfer are not finalized/owner/sale.
risks.early_signal: Empty partial RPC results become safe, finality is generic across EVM, or account clusters become people.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Pin network/event/finality/coverage and test throttles/reorgs/checkpoints; keep exact raw observation and attribution limits.

risks.title: Personal-data lifecycle and transfer
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Actual controller/vendor/region/dataflow/purpose/deletion/retention arrangements are unreviewed.
risks.early_signal: Private watchlist/chat enters search/shared cache/logs or retention defaults are called statutory.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Trace one user through actual/stub dataflow and deletion, then review actual purpose/processors/transfer mechanism at existing gate.

risks.title: Advice-like or reputational output classification
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Actual personalization/output/service classification is fact-specific and not settled by disclaimer.
risks.early_signal: User circumstances drive buy/exit/sizing calls; unsupported crime/safety labels appear.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Evaluate actual Turkish adversarial prompts/templates and retain factual context; review actual service before release/monetization.
risks.review_context: Actual financial-language/service review in docs/19 sections1/6; not a privacy classification or an inferred new gate.

risks.title: Email categories, consent and message classification
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Following, privacy consent, global opt-in and sending authority differ; actual template/IYS classification unresolved.
risks.early_signal: Watchlist automatically enables global mail or consent is checked only at enqueue.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Exercise category withdrawal, current revision, kill switch and origin before stub-send; review actual message templates under G06.

risks.title: Scores, cadences and mobile semantics misunderstood
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Opaque contrast passes are not comprehension or rendered accessibility; personas need different depth.
risks.early_signal: 78/100 is read as probability/safety; fund publication date is hidden; partial chain coverage looks complete.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Observe realistic Turkish mobile/desktop/source tasks and contradictory states; test keyboard/glyph/focus and revise specific misunderstanding.

risks.title: Unproven acquisition/channel and economic proposition
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: No conversion, channel cost, distribution agreement or renewal economics measured.
risks.early_signal: Clicks/testimonials are treated as retained users or fear-based loss prevention drives interest.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Use later authorized transparent audience/channel tests with engaged-job outcomes and actual costs; do not assume a partnership.
risks.review_context: Acquisition/retention remain business hypotheses; G05 relates only to costs of any future authorized activity.

risks.title: Worker starvation, cold start and silent stale state
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: A shared worker and current-data endpoints need not provide fair jobs, baseline coverage or progress.
risks.early_signal: Process green despite old watermarks, stalled corrections or denied history.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Stall/poison/kill jobs, revoke leases, deny history and repeat stale bars through actual integration; inspect queue type age and visible coverage.

risks.title: Competition use of prepared material
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: No organizer ruling exists; preparation authorization does not settle external eligibility.
risks.early_signal: Completed preparation is represented as approved or only event-time work.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Retain contribution history and existing G01 ruling requirement before competition use; continue authorized preparation.

risks.title: Brand/name adoption and attention tradeoff
risks.known_boundary_or_unknown: Izvanta/domain/mark/similarity and designer approval remain unresolved; logo is raster concept.
risks.early_signal: Public adoption claims worldwide uniqueness or branding substitutes for customer/capability evidence.
risks.smallest_next_learning_probe: Before adoption, resolve dated authoritative availability/similarity and actual design/comprehension; prioritize proven task value.
risks.review_context: G09 covers designer approval, not official domain/mark/name-rights clearance; the latter remains unresolved separately in NAMING_AND_LOGO.
